summary: Join our facility construction and project management course to develop vital skills for success. Learn from industry professionals and advance your career!
lede: Facility construction project management coordinates scope, design, procurement, site delivery, and operational handover. This course is for professionals who manage or coordinate facility projects, and develops practical skills in building work breakdown structures and schedules, tracking costs and risks, managing design information and changes, and planning quality checks, safety controls, commissioning, and handover.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate facility construction decisions, controls, contracts, site delivery, or operational handover. It suits intermediate practitioners and experienced professionals who want a stronger integrated project control approach rather than a purely theoretical review.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to construction, facilities, engineering, project controls, contract administration, or capital project delivery. Prior experience with a project schedule, cost report, drawing register, site inspection record, or contractor progress report is useful. No programming is required, and the course uses digital tools at an operational application level rather than technical engineering or production-system implementation level. Advanced topics such as BIM coordination, earned value, AI-assisted schedule analysis, and contract claims are introduced through guided exercises and controlled examples.
